primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-hom-limits (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 554-559

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: reduce past T_0 using the base-change remark so B = Spec(R) is affine; choose affine etale covers U -> X and V -> U x_X U; by the hom-sheaf-in-X lemma Hom(F, G) is the equalizer of two maps between Hom(F|_U, G|_U) and Hom(F|_V, G|_V), reducing to X affine; in the affine case the claim is the colimit-commutation of Hom, which holds when M is of finite presentation over A (i.e. F of finite presentation) by the Algebra colimit lemma (source lines 561-605)
